units.source_text: 云居雁正在昼寝。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was taking a nap in the daytime.

units.source_text: 她身穿一件轻罗单衫躺着，看来颇有凉爽之感。

en.t: She lay there wearing a single robe of light gauze, looking quite cool and comfortable.

units.source_text: 身材小巧玲珑，姿态十分可爱。

en.t: Her figure was small and delicate, and her pose was very charming.

units.source_text: 罗衫透露肌肤，晶莹如玉。

en.t: Her skin showed faintly through the gauze robe, clear and lustrous like jade.

units.source_text: 一手以美妙的姿势拿着扇子，枕腕而卧。

en.t: With one hand she held a fan in a graceful pose and lay with her arm for a pillow.

units.source_text: 头发乱抛在后面，虽不甚长，但末端浓艳，非常美丽。

en.t: Her hair was tossed loosely behind her; though it was not very long, its ends were thick, glossy, and very beautiful.

units.source_text: 众侍女也都躺在帷屏背后休息，因此内大臣走进室内，云居雁并不知道，没有立刻醒来。

en.t: The serving women were all resting behind the curtains and screens, so when the Minister of the Interior entered the room, Kumoi no Kari did not notice and did not wake at once.

units.source_text: 内大臣拍拍扇子，她才睁开眼睛，漫不经心地仰望父亲，那眼色异常可爱。

en.t: Only when the Minister tapped his fan did she open her eyes and look up casually at her father, and the look in her eyes was exceptionally lovely.

units.source_text: 羞涩之下，红晕满颊。

en.t: In her shyness, a blush spread across her cheeks.

units.source_text: 做父亲的看了觉得这女儿长得真标致啊！

en.t: Seeing her as a father, he thought how truly beautiful his daughter had become.

units.source_text: 内大臣对她言道：“我常常劝诫你，白天不可打瞌睡，怎么你又随随便便地睡着了？

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said to her, "I am always warning you not to doze off during the day, so why have you fallen asleep so carelessly again?

units.source_text: 侍女们怎么都不在你身边，哪里去了？

en.t: Why are none of your attendants at your side? Where have they gone?

units.source_text: 女儿家一举一动都该留意，要守身如玉才好。

en.t: A young lady should take care in every movement and guard herself as purely as jade.

units.source_text: 过分放任不羁，便成下等女子。

en.t: If she is too unrestrained and undisciplined, she becomes a vulgar woman.

units.source_text: 但过分拘谨，像僧人念不动明王的陀罗尼咒或做手印时一样严肃，则又是讨厌的。

en.t: But if she is too stiff and solemn, like a monk chanting Fudo Myoo's dharani or making ritual hand signs, that too is unpleasant.

units.source_text: 对眼前亲近之人也疏远冷淡，戒备森严，看似高贵稳重，其实很不雅观，很不可爱。

en.t: To be distant and cold even toward those close at hand, keeping strict guard, may seem noble and composed, but in fact it is unattractive and not at all endearing.

units.source_text: 太政大臣正在教养他的小女公子，准备她将来做皇后。

en.t: The Chancellor is now educating his youngest daughter, preparing her to become empress in the future.

units.source_text: 其教育方针是要她通晓万事，而不专长某一种艺能。

en.t: His policy is to make her knowledgeable in all things, rather than especially skilled in any single art.

units.source_text: 要她对无论何事都明白了解，养成多闻博识的才器。

en.t: He wants her to understand whatever she encounters and to develop the capacity of a widely informed and learned person.

units.source_text: 这方针固然是恰当的。

en.t: That policy is certainly a fitting one.

units.source_text: 然而一个人生来各有特长，各自在思想上与行为上显露出来，各自养成一种人品。

en.t: Yet each person is born with particular strengths, which show themselves in thought and conduct and shape that person's character.

units.source_text: 这位小女公子将来长大，入宫供职之时，定然自有一种优秀品质吧。”

en.t: When that young lady grows up and enters palace service, she will surely have some excellent quality of her own."

units.source_text: 后来又说：“我指望你入宫去当女御，看来此事难以如愿了。

en.t: Later he added, "I had hoped to send you to court as a lady consort, but it seems that wish will be difficult to fulfill.

units.source_text: 但我总须设法使你勿为世人所取笑。

en.t: Still, I must find some way to keep you from being laughed at by the world.

units.source_text: 我每逢听到人家女儿贤愚善恶种种情状，总是替你的前途担心。

en.t: Whenever I hear all sorts of things about other people's daughters, whether wise or foolish, good or bad, I always worry about your future.

units.source_text: 今后你对于假装热诚求爱而来试探你的人，暂时不要理睬。

en.t: From now on, for the time being, pay no attention to anyone who pretends to court you ardently in order to test you.

units.source_text: 我自有主意。”

en.t: I have my own plans."

units.source_text: 他满怀慈爱地说了这番话。

en.t: He spoke these words with deep affection.

units.source_text: 云居雁回忆从前年幼无知，轻举妄动，惹起了世人纷纷议论，而还是恬不知耻地与父亲见面，觉得满怀悔恨，不胜羞愧。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari remembered how, in her youthful ignorance, she had acted rashly and stirred up gossip, yet had still faced her father without shame; she was filled with regret and overcome with embarrassment.

units.source_text: 祖母许久不见孙女，常常来信诉说怨恨之情。

en.t: Her grandmother, having gone so long without seeing her granddaughter, often sent letters complaining of her resentment.

units.source_text: 但因内大臣有言在先，故云居雁亦未便前往探访。

en.t: But because the Minister of the Interior had already given his instructions, Kumoi no Kari could not very well go to visit her.
